channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Writers, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Writers, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Writers prize - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Berggruen Prize Essay Competition 2026: A New Axial Age?
    https://berggruen.org/eu/essay-competition-open
    Berggruen Institute · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · USD 50,000 for the winning English essay and USD 50,000 for the winning Chinese essay. If there is more than one winner in a language category, the prize is split evenly. Winning essays are published through BI Press or Noema. No entry fee.

item.title: 2 new Writers prizes - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• The Richell Prize for Emerging Writers 2026
    https://emergingwritersfestival.org.au/richell-prize-2026/
    Emerging Writers' Festival and Hachette Australia · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · AUD $10,000 prize money (donated by Hachette Australia); 12-month mentorship with a Hachette Australia publisher; first option to consider finished work for publication. Long- and short-listed writers also eligible to apply for a Casa Morphosi Residency in Abruzzo, Italy. No application fee.
  • Jamverse Jam (Protocolized worldbuilding contest)
    https://protocolized.summerofprotocols.com/p/jamverse-jam
    Protocolized (Summer of Protocols) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · One USD 1,000 grand prize plus at least 10 additional USD 200 prizes; winning artifacts are published on the Jamverse website. No entry fee.
